statusText: Tail remains below the blocking threshold; mapped policy state: EA_ON.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next concentrated conditional risk window is Friday's U.S. cash-open, Chicago PMI, Warsh, Michigan and CES benchmark sequence.
headline: Tail low; Friday policy-data cluster dominates near-term stress
body: Thursday's Nasdaq rally was technology-led, with Nvidia up sharply, but the cash session contained meaningful retracement. Fresh shared context collected at 23:14 UTC showed delayed NQ -0.22% and ES -0.14%, while Marvell slipped after hours. Direct post-reopen NQ pullback depth and failed-retracement structure were not independently verified.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail ranged from 17% to 24%. WATCH states clustered around Nvidia-led continuation and the U.S. open; later two-way trade repeatedly pulled Tail back below the blocking threshold. The 06:00 UTC slot has no published assessment.
outlookSummary: Overnight Stress should ease somewhat before rebuilding into the 13:45-14:00 UTC Friday cluster. Tail remains conditional on observed price-path persistence, especially opening-auction continuation, shallow pullbacks, cross-asset alignment or delayed second-leg repricing.
